name: Gad
summary: A prophet, called David's seer, who brought the LORD's word to David. He told David where to go when he was hiding from Saul, and after David numbered the people he brought the LORD's three choices and the command to build an altar.

key_moments.title: Tells David to Leave the Stronghold
key_moments.description: The prophet Gad told David not to stay in the stronghold but to go into the land of Judah. So David went to the forest of Hareth.

key_moments.title: Brings David Three Choices
key_moments.description: After David numbered the people, the LORD sent Gad to offer him three things: seven years of famine, three months fleeing his enemies, or three days of plague. David chose to be punished by the LORD rather than by men, for His mercies are great.

key_moments.title: Tells David to Build an Altar
key_moments.description: When the LORD stopped the angel at Jerusalem, Gad told David to build an altar to the LORD at the threshing floor of Araunah. David did as Gad said and went up.
